title: Return to Mos Espa
front_description: Obsessed with an urgent need to check on his mother's safety, Anakin Skywalker leaves Naboo and ventures to the desert planet of his childhood, Tatooine. With Padmé by his side, Anakin first visits the bustling streets of Mos Espa and confronts his old "master" Watto, the Toydarian junk dealer. Watto tells the young Jedi that his mother was freed from bondage by the good man who married her, Cliegg Lars.
back_description: Doug Chiang's rendering of Amidala's shivery starship, piloted to Tatooine by Anakin.
